acceptance: Synthetic pipeline regression passes

evidence.description: 81 frontend tests passed with local socket access
evidence.limitations: Node tests, not actual microphone or visual acceptance
evidence.stale_reason: Relevant tracked content or declared behavior changed

evidence.description: Local Ollama tags endpoint did not respond within 2 seconds
evidence.limitations: Does not prove software is uninstalled; only that this endpoint did not respond

evidence.description: 62 targeted beta/profile/parser/voice tests passed with synthetic databases
evidence.command: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_beta_ollama.py backend/tests/test_beta_profile.py backend/tests/test_command_parser.py backend/tests/test_beta_voice.py -q
evidence.limitations: Normal Windows access and isolated workspace temp paths; one deprecation warning; mocked inference, no live microphone

evidence.description: Six initial new pipeline regressions passed; subsequent full run includes fourteen passing pipeline cases
evidence.limitations: Synthetic frames, fake models and asyncio handoff; no actual audio inference

evidence.description: Final backend suite: 445 passed, 13 failed, 2 warnings; all remaining failures reproduced using original voice module
evidence.limitations: Suite uses synthetic databases; baseline comparison 430 passed and 14 failed; no live microphone or wake-model training

evidence.description: Actual owner-audio measurement completed:9 eligible command clips; beam1 raw WER14.5%, median1.727s; beam5 WER12.9%, median1.873s. One reference-mismatch exclusion confirmed by owner.
evidence.command: scripts/evaluate_voice.py with derived local ASR manifest; same-model beam5 comparison
evidence.limitations: Small validation session; equivalent number formatting counts as WER edits; supplied-file decoding only, no live endpointing or trained wake model

evidence.description: Actual CUDA inference failed: Library cublas64_12.dll is not found or cannot be loaded
evidence.command: WHISPER_DEVICE=cuda WHISPER_COMPUTE_TYPE=int8_float16 scripts/evaluate_voice.py on local clips
evidence.limitations: GPU enumeration succeeded but decoding failed; no CUDA library install or performance claim

proposals.title: VEGA Voice Pilot: voice-first Windows operation
proposals.reason: Owner selected computer operation on 2026-10-28; free first, optional INR100–300/month. Research and five-workflow proposal: docs/VEGA_RESEARCH_2026-10-28.md and docs/VEGA_VOICE_PILOT_MVP.md. Next proposed milestone V1 compares a bounded desktop driver with a narrow UIA baseline. No new desktop capability implemented; original stage counts retained. Product ordering superseded by P-002: driver smoke tests remain internal engineering work; follow docs/VEGA_PERSONAL_OS_PLAN.md for the next proposed step.

proposals.title: Goal-aware desktop companion: daily plans, personal cards and approved routines
proposals.reason: Owner clarified broad personal autonomy with a November 1 LeetCode/GSoC proving journey. Research and design in docs/VEGA_PERSONAL_OS_PLAN.md replace the earlier driver-first product ordering. Proposed D1 delivers goal -> desktop card -> resource -> session outcome; D2 learning, D3 adaptive planning, D4 voice/cross-app routines, D5 native pilot. No new application functionality implemented. Accepted legacy stages unchanged.
